name: TagAvg
description: Time-weighted average of a tag or attribute over a time range.

params.name: tag
params.description: tag or attribute name in single quotes

notes: Because it is time-weighted, re-evaluating it with no new data still changes the result as time advances. Use TagMean for an event-weighted mean. An optional minimum percent-good argument is mentioned in some material but is not confirmed here.

name: TagTot
description: Time integral (totalizer) of a rate over a time range. It assumes the input is in units per day and has no knowledge of the tag's actual units.

params.name: tag
params.description: tag or attribute name in single quotes

notes: Multiply by 24 for a per-hour rate. Forgetting the per-day assumption gives totals 24 times too small for per-hour rates.

name: TagMean
description: Event-weighted (arithmetic) mean of the recorded events in a range. Most PI summary functions are time-weighted; TagMean is the exception.

params.name: tag
params.description: tag or attribute name in single quotes

notes: The example multiplies by EventCount to get an event-weighted sum, month to date.
